document.abstract: The Toronto Section’s second annual student-focused meeting took place on 9 February 2021, with 157 participants, who attended virtually via Zoom. This special event covered “IP for Broadcast, Virtual Immerse, eSports,” which included several topics that attracted students interested in new media technology. The goal was to present the breadth of our new technologies and give them an idea of the potential opportunities.
